description: Send an enquiry to a Cyclesite seller on the buyer's behalf. It's saved to the buyer's Cyclesite inbox, where the seller's reply also arrives, and the seller is notified. Per-buyer-per-listing daily cap (2/day) prevents spam. Requires OAuth scope `enquiries:respond` (the scope name is shared with seller-side replies). Example: 'message the seller of that Trek and ask whether it has had a service this year and if Saturday collection in Manchester works'.

message.description: The buyer's question to the seller (10-1930 chars).

name: make_enquiry
title: Send a buyer enquiry
